# Symbols exempt from TestNoFreshOrphanedAllowEntries because they predate the
# gate. Each names a retire_ticket that is ALREADY CLOSED and a caller_site that
# does not exist, so nothing will ever retire it and no count could see it.
#
# THIS LIST IS SHRINK-ONLY. Never append to it. A new gap gets wired, or marked
# UNOWNED (which the debt ratchet in testonly-debt-baseline.txt counts), never
# parked here. Removing an entry means the symbol got a real caller: delete the
# line and lower the debt baseline in the same change.
#
# Lines beginning with "#" are comments. See
# DEFECT-orphaned-allow-entries-systemic.md for how this list was measured.
